title: Region entry text repeats the original 'unrested' framing and companion dialogue verbatim on a later visit even after that hold's grief is fully rested. Re-entering the Shieldings after the White Rod rite still opened with 'both lines have held their ground, unrested, ever since' and Lys said 'I can already hear drilling from here' about the muster barn we had already broken up two visits earlier.
